title: Country Swing Dancing **THE BASICS** Tutorial!
channel: Grant & Shalee - King & Queen of Country Swing

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor pair breaks down each move clearly by giving separate directions for leads and follows. They use a friendly, encouraging tone with humorous banter to keep the atmosphere light.
cues: Tuck your elbows into your sides
common_mistakes: Being too rigid or loose in connection
Throwing partner out instead of keeping them close
Straightening the bottom leg during the dip
safety: Keep the bottom leg bent during the dip to relieve pressure

steps_taught.name: The Basic Step
steps_taught.description: Step across to the left and pivot

steps_taught.name: The Back Slide
steps_taught.description: Back slide and turn the lady

steps_taught.name: The Basic Dip
steps_taught.description: Dip with a lunge and bend the bottom leg

steps_taught.name: Slow Dancing
steps_taught.description: Quarter turn step forward and rock step

what_works: Clear step-by-step instructions for both partners
what_hinders: Lack of counts makes timing harder to follow

quotes.text: What we want to do is first start with connection.
Keeping your partner really close to you.
The back slide and the turn can be done back to back.
If you're not comfortable dipping, that's perfectly fine.
